title: Seared Steak with Chimichurri
description: A hard-seared ribeye or strip steak topped with a punchy, herbaceous chimichurri. The kind of 25-minute dinner that feels like a treat but requires almost no skill.

ingredients.name: boneless ribeye or NY strip steaks

steps.text: Make the chimichurri: Stir together parsley, oregano, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, red pepper flakes, and fine salt. Set aside — it gets better as it sits.
Pat steaks completely dry with paper towels. Season generously with kosher salt and pepper on all sides.
Heat vegetable oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat until the oil just begins to smoke.
Lay steaks in the pan away from you. Sear without moving until a deep, dark brown crust forms on the bottom, 3 to 4 minutes.
Flip and cook 3 to 4 minutes more for medium-rare (130°F on an instant-read thermometer). For medium, go another minute or two (135-140°F).
Transfer steaks to a cutting board and rest for 5 minutes — the carryover heat will bring them up another 5 degrees.
Slice against the grain and spoon chimichurri generously over the top. Serve the remaining chimichurri alongside.
